notes: The warm climate ripens grapes easily, and winemakers more often need to add acid than sugar.
Chenin Blanc is often made to drink young, with rich tropical notes such as banana, guava, pear and pineapple.
Constantia was famous for an unfortified sweet wine made mostly from Muscat, and its estates still make sweet wines in homage, such as Vin de Constance.
Stellenbosch Cabernet Sauvignon is noted for heavy, full-bodied wines.
Western Cape wines range from sturdy Rhône-style reds to aromatic Sauvignon Blanc from vineyards cooled by Atlantic breezes.
The Swartland was traditionally a source of robust, full-bodied reds and high-quality fortified wines.
